description: One case per open failure in data/. expected_tools are the evidence sources a good investigation must use (get_pipeline_run is implied). acceptable_actions lists every reasonable recommended_action.

cases.reference_root_cause: The client secret of service principal sp-crm-ingest used by linked service ls_adls_crm expired on 2026-10-18; it must be rotated in Key Vault before rerunning.

A cloud-governance IAM cleanup on 2026-10-18 removed the Storage Blob Data Contributor role from the adf-retail-prod managed identity on the gold container, so writes to gold/finance are forbidden (403).
The POS source added a new column region_code (release v5.2 on 2026-10-18), so the stores file has 9 columns while the dataset expects 8.
Input volume grew about 36% in a week during the festive season and gold.fact_sales is rewritten in full every run, so the notebook duration rose steadily until it hit the 60-minute activity timeout.
Data skew on store_id: the online store S-0001 is 41% of rows, so one task read 9.6 GB versus a 118 MB median and ran out of memory; AQE skew join handling is disabled.

The gold pipeline did not run because its upstream pipeline pl_transform_silver_sales failed today with an out-of-memory error caused by data skew on store_id; the upstream run must be fixed and rerun first.

Yesterday's sales file was resent as sales_20261018_v2.csv with the same MD5 hash, so every transaction_id was already loaded and the uniqueness check stopped the batch; today's sales file has not been delivered.
The inventory file arrived late at 03:05 (SLA 02:00) because of a month-end stock count, after the 02:15 run had started; it has now arrived, so a rerun is enough.
The CRM release on 2026-10-18 made email nullable for guest checkout customers, so 7.4% of emails are null and the 0% mandatory-column check failed; the data owner must decide the rule.
The Snowflake resource monitor RM_MONTHLY_REPORTING used 100% of its 500-credit monthly quota, so warehouse WH_REPORTING is suspended; the platform owner must raise the quota.

Transient TCP connection resets on the ExpressRoute gateway during the 02:20-02:35 maintenance window; the same error succeeded on manual reruns on the 14th and 17th and the connection test passes now.
The self-hosted integration runtime shir-onprem-01 is offline because its VM rebooted for Windows patching and the DIAHostService service (startup type Manual) did not start.
